subject: Pricing follow-up: target $/1M tokens benchmarking (OpenAI / Anthropic / hosts)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing follow-up: target $/1M tokens benchmarking (OpenAI / Anthropic / hosts)

Hi Ellen —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our side after the discovery:

Summary from call:
- Expected production volume: 150–250M tokens/month in Q3, scaling to ~1B tokens/month in Q4 if pilot metrics hold.
- Primary workload: real-time chat for customer support (low-latency, <150ms tail preferred) plus nightly reranks for personalization.
- Model preference: prefer open models (LlamaX-style) for cost control, but want fallback to higher-quality hosted models when latency/consistency matters.
- Current target unit economics: your finance team mentioned target $/1M tokens in the $300–$600 range, depending on latency/availability SLAs.

Attachments I’m sending: redwood_pricing_vs_hosts.xlsx (benchmark table), token_volume_table.csv (your volumes mapped to cost tiers).

Quick asks / proposed next steps:
1) Can you confirm the representative monthly peak and steady-state token numbers we discussed? (I filled a suggested table in token_volume_table.csv.)
2) Target price check: based on preliminary benchmarking, to hit $400 / 1M tokens we recommend a mixed routing policy: 70% open-model (quantized + batch optimizations) + 30% hosted high-quality for critical requests. I included a line-itemized estimate in the attached spreadsheet. Is $400 / 1M tokens a realistic target for Acme to evaluate?
3) If helpful, we can run a short 2-week proof-of-effort on Dedicated to validate throughput and real unit economics — I noted expected costs and ramp assumptions in the spreadsheet.

If you’re good with the assumptions I’ll loop in solutions engineering to scope the pilot and produce a final per-token target by end of week.

Thanks —
Vanessa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: redwood_pricing_vs_hosts.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB), token_volume_table.csv (csv, 4KB)

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: target $/1M tokens benchmarking (OpenAI / Anthropic / hosts)

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the recap and the files. A few clarifications from our side after chatting with finance and platform:

- Volume: the 150–250M is our earliest ramp (pilot). If pilot goes well, our target is 900–1,100M tokens/month by Dec. I updated the CSV and attached it.
- Target $/1M: finance is comfortable testing at $400 / 1M for the pilot, but they’ve asked for a clear comparison vs OpenAI and Anthropic at the same quality tier.
- Model expectations: for chat we want comparable quality to gpt-4o-mini for customer-facing responses; for internal reranks we can tolerate slightly lower-quality open models.

Can you send a short one-pager or a table that shows:
  a) Estimated $/1M at pilot (200M) and at scale (1B) for Redwood (mixed routing)
  b) Comparable pricing from OpenAI and Anthropic (assume their current published rates for similar throughput)
  c) Any one-time or reserved costs we should include (Dedicated commit, data egress, observability add-ons)

Also, timeline question: how long to stand up a 2-week Dedicated pilot if we sign a Letter of Intent?

Best,
Ellen
Head of Product Ops
Acme Inc

Attachment stubs: token_volume_table_acme_v2.csv (csv, 4KB)

Thanks Vanessa —

Quick draft notes (I put a first-pass table into the Drive link):
- Assumptions: 70% open quantized LlamaX-v1 (8-bit), 30% hosted high-quality (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini). We assume 3x batching efficiency and 15% prefix cache hit rate for chat workloads.

Estimated $/1M (rounded):
- Redwood (pilot ~200M): $380 / 1M tokens (pilot pricing, includes initial 2-week Dedicated pilot amortized across pilot period)
- Redwood (scale ~1B): $310 / 1M tokens (volume discount + sustained batching/kv cache benefits)
\Published comparators (approximate published + usage economics):
- OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini equivalent): $1,200 / 1M tokens (hosted, no quantization; higher per-token but lower ops for dev)
- Anthropic (claude-hosted equivalent): $950 / 1M tokens
- Other open-model hosts (managed LlamaX): $450–700 / 1M tokens depending on commit and SLA
\One-time / reserved costs to call out:
- Dedicated commit (recommended pilot commit): ~$18k for 2 weeks of reserved Dedicated capacity (amortized into pilot pricing above)
- Onboarding & SSO/security review: one-time professional services ~ $6k (optional)
- Observability add-on (30-day retention): $1.5k/month (optional)
\Timeline for 2-week Dedicated pilot: 5–7 business days to provision and run basic validation once LOI is signed and we have required contacts for networking/KMS. Full integration (SAML, custom routing) may add 1–2 weeks.
\I flagged the Drive doc "ACME_pricing_onepager_v1" with the table and a 2-sentence summary. Vanessa — happy to refine before you send.
\—Marissa

Redwood Inference
